terms.definitionEn: A web platform function that starts a request and returns a promise for a Response object.
terms.definitionAr: دالة من web platform بتبدأ request وبترجع promise لكائن Response.

terms.definitionEn: A promise-like asynchronous result whose fulfilled value is represented by the supplied type.
terms.definitionAr: نتيجة غير متزامنة قيمتها بعد النجاح بيمثلها النوع المكتوب بين الأقواس.

terms.definitionEn: A safe type for data of an unverified shape that must be checked before typed use.
terms.definitionAr: نوع آمن لبيانات شكلها لسه متحققش ولازم نفحصها قبل الاستخدام المحدد.

terms.definitionEn: A type that allows operations without checking the value's actual shape.
terms.definitionAr: نوع بيسمح بعمليات من غير فحص الشكل الحقيقي للقيمة.

terms.definitionEn: A condition that tests whether a value is nullish or present before accessing it.
terms.definitionAr: شرط بيتأكد إذا كانت القيمة nullish أو موجودة قبل الوصول ليها.

terms.definitionEn: The web platform object returned by fetch, containing status information and methods for reading a body.
terms.definitionAr: كائن من web platform بترجعه fetch وفيه بيانات الحالة وmethods لقراءة body.

terms.definitionEn: A method that reads a response body as JSON data and returns a promise for the parsed result.
terms.definitionAr: method بتقرأ body الاستجابة كـ JSON وبتُرجع promise بالقيمة المحللة.

terms.definitionEn: A syntax operator that stops a property access chain when its left value is nullish.
terms.definitionAr: صياغة بتوقف سلسلة الوصول للخصائص لما القيمة اللي على الشمال تكون nullish.

terms.definitionEn: An operator that chooses a fallback only when the left operand is null or undefined.
terms.definitionAr: operator بيختار قيمة بديلة بس لما القيمة الأولى تكون null أو undefined.

terms.definitionEn: A compile-time instruction to treat an expression as a compatible type without performing runtime validation.
terms.definitionAr: تعليمات وقت الترجمة للتعامل مع expression كنوع متوافق من غير فحص حقيقي وقت التشغيل.

terms.definitionEn: A postfix marker that tells the checker to remove null and undefined from an expression's static type.
terms.definitionAr: علامة بعد expression بتطلب من الـ checker يشيل null وundefined من النوع الثابت.

terms.definitionEn: A check performed while the program runs to verify untrusted data actually matches an expected shape.
terms.definitionAr: فحص بيتعمل وقت تشغيل البرنامج عشان يتأكد إن البيانات غير الموثوقة مطابقة للشكل المتوقع.
terms.example: if (typeof body === 'object' && body !== null) { /* inspect fields */ }

questions.code: async function loadUsers() { const response = await fetch('/api/users'); }
questions.question: What does awaiting fetch produce before the body is parsed?
options: A Response object with status and body-reading methods
The JSON body already converted into a User array
A string containing the full response headers and body
A promise that still needs to be awaited a second time
questions.explanation: fetch fulfills with a Response; reading JSON requires a separate body method.
questions.explanationAr: fetch بترجع Response بعد النجاح، وقراءة JSON محتاجة method منفصلة.

questions.code: async function parseResponse(response: Response) { const data: unknown = await response.json(); return data; }
questions.question: Why is unknown a useful destination type here?
options: It guarantees the parsed JSON already matches the declared User interface without inspecting its fields
It accepts the parsed value but requires checks before using its shape
It converts all JSON properties to strings before assigning the value to data
It makes the response body validate itself against the interface while parsing
questions.explanation: unknown accepts the result while preventing unchecked property access until narrowing.
questions.explanationAr: unknown بيقبل النتيجة وبيمنع الوصول غير المتحقق للخصائص لحد التضييق.

questions.code: async function loadUser(): Promise<User> { return user; }
questions.question: What does Promise<User> describe?
options: The function runs synchronously and returns a User immediately
The function can return any JSON shape without checking
The promise fulfills with a value compatible with User
The function automatically validates user fields at runtime
questions.explanation: The generic argument describes the fulfilled value type of the returned promise.
questions.explanationAr: النوع بين الأقواس بيوصف نوع القيمة اللي الـ promise هتنجح بيها.

questions.question: What happens if user or profile is nullish?
options: The property chain throws before label is assigned
The missing value is converted into an empty string
The program retries the request automatically
The chain stops and the result is undefined
questions.explanation: Optional chaining short-circuits the remaining access and yields undefined.
questions.explanationAr: الـ optional chaining بتوقف باقي الوصول وبتطلع undefined.

questions.question: When does the fallback 'Guest' get selected?
options: Whenever apiName is an empty string, even though it is already present
Whenever apiName is any falsy value other than null or undefined, including zero
Only when apiName has not been declared anywhere in the current scope
When apiName is null or undefined
questions.explanation: Nullish coalescing falls back only for null and undefined.
questions.explanationAr: الـ nullish coalescing بتستخدم البديل بس مع null وundefined.

questions.code: async function checkStatus() { const response = await fetch('/api'); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Request failed'); }
questions.question: What does response.ok indicate?
options: Whether the response body contains syntactically valid JSON that can be parsed
Whether the HTTP status is in the successful 200–299 range
Whether the fetch call resolved to a Response object instead of rejecting
Whether TypeScript verified every response field against a declared interface
questions.explanation: The ok property is true for successful HTTP status codes in the 200–299 range.
questions.explanationAr: الخاصية ok بتكون true لحالات HTTP الناجحة من 200 لحد 299.

questions.question: What does this assertion do at runtime?
options: It checks that body has every User property before allowing the assignment
It converts body into a newly constructed User instance with class methods
It adds User fields that were missing from the JSON using interface defaults
Nothing; the assertion changes static typing but performs no runtime check
questions.explanation: A type assertion is erased and does not validate or transform the value.
questions.explanationAr: الـ assertion بتتشال ومابتفحصش القيمة أو تحولها وقت التشغيل.

questions.question: What does the postfix exclamation mark tell TypeScript?
options: Throw a runtime error if user is missing before reading its name property
Validate user.name against the declared interface before returning it to the caller
Remove null and undefined from the static type without checking at runtime
Use optional access to skip the read and return undefined whenever user is missing
questions.explanation: The non-null assertion affects the static type only; it adds no runtime guard.
questions.explanationAr: الـ non-null assertion بتأثر على النوع الثابت بس ومابتضيفش فحص وقت التشغيل.

questions.code: async function read(response: Response) { const body: any = await response.json(); body.user.profile.name.toUpperCase(); }
questions.question: What is the main risk of using any for this untrusted body?
options: Misspelled or absent fields may pass type checking and fail at runtime
Every property access is converted into a safe optional chain before being evaluated
The JSON parser rejects values unless they match a declared interface provided to it
TypeScript verifies the response against every field of User before allowing access
questions.explanation: any suppresses static checks, so malformed data may cause runtime failures.
questions.explanationAr: any بيعطل الفحوصات الثابتة، فبيانات شكلها غلط ممكن تعمل أخطاء وقت التشغيل.

questions.code:
const id: string | null = null;
const label = id ?? 'guest';
questions.question: What runtime value is assigned to label?
options: 'guest'
null
undefined
An empty string
questions.explanation: The left operand is null, so the fallback string is selected.
questions.explanationAr: القيمة الأولى null، فالقيمة البديلة النصية هي اللي بتتختار.

questions.code:
const user = { profile: { name: 'Mina' } };
const label = user.profile?.name;
questions.question: What runtime value is assigned to label?
options: undefined
'profile'
null
'Mina'
questions.explanation: The profile exists, so optional chaining reads and returns its name property.
questions.explanationAr: الـ profile موجودة، فالـ optional chaining بتقرأ وترجع خاصية name.

questions.question: What type does Data resolve to after unwrapping the promise?
questions.explanation: Awaited recursively extracts the value type represented by a promise-like type.
questions.explanationAr: Awaited بتستخرج بشكل متكرر نوع القيمة اللي بيمثلها promise-like type.

questions.prompt: Declare the asynchronous function result as a promise of User.
questions.explanation: An async function can explicitly annotate its fulfilled result using Promise<User>.
questions.explanationAr: الدالة async ينفع تحدد نتيجة نجاحها بشكل صريح باستخدام Promise<User>.

questions.prompt: Keep parsed external data unchecked until it has been narrowed.
questions.explanation: unknown accepts the parsed value while requiring validation before typed use.
questions.explanationAr: unknown بيقبل القيمة المحللة وبيطلب تحقق قبل الاستخدام المحدد.

questions.prompt: Read the response body as JSON after the request succeeds.
questions.explanation: The json method parses the response body and returns a promise for the result.
questions.explanationAr: method json بتحلل body الاستجابة وبتُرجع promise بالنتيجة.

questions.prompt: Access profile only when user is not nullish.
questions.explanation: Optional chaining avoids the property access when user is nullish.
questions.explanationAr: الـ optional chaining بتمنع الوصول للخاصية لما user تكون nullish.

questions.prompt: Use the fallback only when result is null or undefined.
questions.explanation: The nullish coalescing operator selects the right side for null or undefined.
questions.explanationAr: operator ?? بيختار الناحية اليمين مع null أو undefined.

questions.prompt: Add a static assertion to the value; remember this does not validate JSON.
questions.explanation: The as syntax asserts a type to the checker but performs no runtime validation.
questions.explanationAr: صياغة as بتحدد نوع للـ checker لكنها مابتعملش تحقق وقت التشغيل.

questions.prompt: Tell the checker this expression is not nullish without adding a runtime check.
questions.explanation: The postfix assertion removes nullish types statically but does not check the value.
questions.explanationAr: العلامة بعد القيمة بتشيل الأنواع nullish ثابتًا من غير فحص فعلي.

questions.prompt: Narrow this possibly missing user before reading its name.
questions.code:
declare const user: User | null;
if (user ____ null) { user.name; }
questions.explanation: An explicit null comparison narrows the value inside the true branch.
questions.explanationAr: المقارنة الصريحة مع null بتضيق النوع جوه الفرع true.

questions.question: Why should fetch handling distinguish the Response from its JSON body?
keyPoints: fetch resolves to a Response object
Body parsing is a separate asynchronous operation
HTTP error status does not by itself reject fetch
questions.modelAnswer: fetch resolves to a Response that exposes status and body-reading methods; it does not directly return the parsed payload. Calling json is a separate asynchronous operation. An HTTP error status generally still fulfills fetch, so code should inspect response.ok or status before using the body.
questions.explanation: Request completion, HTTP status, and body parsing are separate steps.
questions.explanationAr: اكتمال الطلب وحالة HTTP وقراءة body خطوات منفصلة.

questions.question: Why is assigning parsed JSON to unknown safer than any?
keyPoints: JSON data is not proven to match an application interface
unknown requires checks before property-specific use
any suppresses checks that could reveal mistakes
questions.modelAnswer: Parsed JSON comes from an external boundary and is not proven to match an application interface. unknown lets the value be stored while requiring code to narrow or validate it before accessing fields. any removes many of those checks and can hide incorrect assumptions.
questions.explanation: Treating external data as unknown preserves the need to establish its shape.
questions.explanationAr: التعامل مع البيانات الخارجية كـ unknown بيحافظ على ضرورة فحص شكلها.

questions.question: Why is a type assertion not a substitute for validating an API response?
keyPoints: They do not inspect or transform runtime data
Validation must check the actual received shape
questions.modelAnswer: A type assertion asks the compiler to treat an expression as a type, but it does not inspect the value or add missing fields. A malformed response can still reach the program and fail when used. Runtime validation must check the actual data before trusting it.
questions.explanation: Only runtime checks can establish that untrusted data has the expected shape.
questions.explanationAr: الفحوصات وقت التشغيل هي اللي تقدر تثبت شكل البيانات غير الموثوقة.

questions.question: When are optional chaining and a null check each appropriate?
keyPoints: Optional chaining is concise when absence has a safe fallback result
A null check is useful when the branch needs guarded logic
Both handle nullish values without validating unrelated fields
questions.modelAnswer: Optional chaining is concise when a missing link can safely produce undefined and the expression can continue with a fallback. An explicit null check is clearer when several statements should run only for a present value or when the branch needs stronger narrowing. Neither validates the full shape of external data.
questions.explanation: Choose based on whether absence should short-circuit an expression or guard a block of logic.
questions.explanationAr: الاختيار حسب هل الغياب يوقف expression ولا يحمي مجموعة statements.
